# Vendor onboarding circular 31 (issued 2 June 2026)

From: procurement office
Replaces: vendor onboarding circular 52 and every earlier instruction

The steps below take effect on 1 July 2026 for every new vendor.

1. Obtain dual sign-off from the procurement lead and the budget owner before signing any framework agreement above EUR 20,000.
2. Collect proof of public liability insurance with cover of at least EUR 2,000,000.
3. Verify the vendor's bank details against a bank-issued confirmation dated within the last three months.
files.policy/vendor-circular-52.md:
# Vendor onboarding circular 52 (issued 14 October 2025)

From: procurement office

Keep the following on file for every new vendor:

1. Sign-off from the procurement lead before signing any framework agreement.
2. Proof of public liability insurance with cover of at least EUR 1,000,000.
3. The completed vendor questionnaire, faxed to the shared procurement line.
